name: UxROM
doc: UNROM/UOROM style boards: one register selects the 16 KB PRG bank at $8000, the last bank stays at $C000; CHR is RAM. Written from the nesdev wiki's mapper description; not checked against a program yet.

registers.name: bank select
registers.doc: a write anywhere in $8000-$FFFF; many boards have bus conflicts (the ROM drives the bus while the CPU writes, so write a value the ROM holds at that address)
